study.title: Quantitative angiography prognosis of intracranial aneurysm treatment failure using parametric imaging and distal vessel analysis
study.venue: Proceedings of SPIE--the International Society for Optical Engineering

imaging.modality_detail: Intra-operative DSA, one pre- and one post-coil placement sequence per patient; angiographic parametric imaging (API) maps derived
imaging.territory_detail: Intracranial aneurysms treated with endovascular coils; ROI in parent artery distal to aneurysm neck

task.task_description: Predict six-month occlusion outcome (occluded/not occluded, Raymond-Roy based) of coil-embolized intracranial aneurysms from pre/post-treatment normalized API parameters (TTP, TTA, MTT, PH, AUC) measured in the parent artery distal to the aneurysm, using a dense neural network.
task.clinical_application: Intra-procedural prognosis of coil embolization treatment failure to guide coil placement

temporal_evidence.quote: It does so by tracking the progression of contrast across the DSA sequence at every single pixel and extracting API parameters for every pixel.

metrics.task: six-month occlusion outcome prediction (20-fold Monte Carlo CV, 70/30 split)
six-month occlusion outcome prediction (20-fold Monte Carlo CV, 70/30 split)

comparators: single-parameter ROC analysis (MTT, TTP, TTA, PH, AUC)
